input:
The number of possible solutions of sin θ + sin 4θ + sin 7θ = 0, θ ∈ (0, π) are

Options:
A. 3
B. 4
C. 6
D. 8

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Count the number of values of θ in (0, π) satisfying sin θ + sin 4θ + sin 7θ = 0.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Group sin 7θ + sin θ using sum-to-product formula to get 2 sin 4θ cos 3θ, then factor out sin 4θ to split into two cases.

key_concepts: Sum-to-product formula: sin A + sin B = 2 sin((A+B)/2) cos((A-B)/2)
General solutions of sin θ = 0 and cos θ = -1/2

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Apply sum-to-product to sin 7θ + sin θ, factor out sin 4θ, solve each case and list all θ ∈ (0, π).
logical_steps: Step 1: Rewrite sin 7θ + sin θ using sum-to-product
Step 2: Factor the equation as sin 4θ(2cos 3θ + 1) = 0
Step 5: List all valid θ ∈ (0, π) from both cases
Step 6: Count total and match option

step_1_sum_to_product.expression: sin 7θ + sin θ = 2 sin((7θ+θ)/2) cos((7θ-θ)/2) = 2 sin 4θ cos 3θ

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Case 1 yields 3 solutions {π/4, π/2, 3π/4}; Case 2 yields 3 solutions {2π/9, 4π/9, 8π/9}. All 6 lie in (0, π) and are distinct. Total = 6 ✓
